name: qwen35-ampere02
description: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (AWQ 4-bit) smoke matrix on 2x A100 via stock vLLM.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-23 smoke matrix; excludes the ~26 min model load

caveats: This backend serves with stock vLLM 0.32; the 122B TP2 run needs --disable-custom-all-reduce or it spins in NCCL (serve-server.sh sets it).
The checkpoint is 75 GiB on Lustre and took ~26 min to load in the historical run; the smoke result excludes that.
Qwen3.5 declares 262144 native context; 700K is not supported without a separate long-context extension.
The adapter uses tests/serve_smoke.py because llm/qwen35 has no measure.sh; the matrix shape is the 2026-10-23 one.
Serving resources come from llm/qwen35/config-122b.json, not from this recipe.
